Leisure & Hospitality.one_liner: A branded, membership-based run club with a real post-run social space — riding the trend already pushing Strava toward a $2.2B IPO.
Israel's first dedicated low- and no-alcohol bar, bringing a format already proven in five global cities to a market with none of it.
A paid membership for real-world social activity in a single city — running, climbing, cooking, dinners — with paid hosts instead of volunteers.

Health & Wellness.one_liner: A strength studio built entirely for the 55+ body — small-group sessions, coaches trained for older-adult resistance work, programming organized around real function, not weight loss.
A paid after-school club for 11-16s built around phone-free structured activity — music rooms, a workshop, a kitchen, a court — for the hours between school ending and screens taking over.

Food & Beverage.one_liner: A functional food and drink brand for kids 5-14, with published third-party contaminant testing per batch, for parents who no longer trust the label alone.

Retail & Luxury.one_liner: A resale service for children's clothing and gear with a store-credit mechanic and centralized processing, replacing what parents currently do through scattered Facebook groups.
